description: Accept ONE named check that is failing on a crew's pull request as known and out of the crew's scope (for example a scanner false positive in history the crew cannot rewrite). The crew then goes to review past that check instead of halting on it, automatic CI fixing skips it, and Autopilot never ships the PR. It covers that check on that PR at its current head and later heads descended from it. The check stays red on GitHub; a person approves at the ship gate. Refused when the check is not failing now. A reason is required and recorded with your name in the audit trail. Requires `approve` scope. Only call when the operator asks, and never for a real test, build or lint failure.

checkName.description: The failing check run's name or commit status context, exactly as GitHub shows it.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

reason.description: Why the check is known and out of scope. Required.

name: anyforge_accept_crew_ci_check
title: Accept crew ci check
